goal.title: Your weekly rhythm
goal.intro: Daily flames in Kolo are now weekly orbits. Choose how many days a week you want to practise: reach that and the orbit closes, and your orbit streak grows. Missing a day doesn't break anything.
goal.introNew: Kolo counts weeks, not days. Choose how many days a week you'll practise: reach that and the week's orbit closes and your streak of orbits grows. Missing a day doesn't break anything.
goal.ringCaption: Each dot is a day you practised. Fill enough of them and the orbit closes.

steps.title: Hi! This is Kolo
steps.text: You collect the words you want to learn, and Kolo helps you keep them. Here's how it works — it takes half a minute.

steps.title: How it works
steps.text: Add words, practise them on flashcards — and Perigee, our review engine, brings each word back right when you're about to forget it. A few minutes a day, and words stick for good.
steps.tip: Got a ready-made list? Paste it all at once with Import.

steps.title: Your weekly rhythm
steps.text: Choose how many days a week to practise. Hit your goal and the week's orbit closes and your streak grows — and practice earns XP, levels and capsules with rewards.
